why: The whole board draws about 15-20 mA (NET_SPEC i_max 50 mA) from a battery or current-limited bench supply; there is no motor, relay or long cable, so a fuse would only add a drop.
Hobby board on a 9-12 V battery or adapter with a short lead, no inductive load and no hot-plug from a long cable; a TVS is not worth its cost. Reverse polarity is covered by D2.
